segments.title: Warm-up
instructions: Roll your shoulders and shake out your hands.
Spread your fingers wide, then make a soft fist. Five times.
Right hand: thumb on middle C. Play C D E F G, then back down. Slow and even.
Left hand: pinky on the C below. Play C D E F G, then back down.
Keep your wrists loose and your fingers curved, like holding a ball.

segments.title: Technique
instructions: Turn on the metronome if you like, and play one note per click.
Right hand: C D E F G and back, three times.
Left hand: the same pattern, three times.
Now try both hands together, very slowly.
Feeling good? Try the C scale: thumb tucks under after E.

segments.title: Song work
instructions: Play the first line slowly. Mistakes are fine.
Repeat any tricky bar three times, then go on.

segments.title: Free play
instructions: Pick a new sound on your keyboard and explore it.
Make up a little tune using only the black keys.
No wrong notes here. Just enjoy it.
